summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (plus private helpers), exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was committed and no tests or repository code were run; verification was limited to confirming no line exceeds 120 characters. Black and flake8 were not run. One correction to my earlier summary: the loader module has a single private path-resolution helper, `_resolve_path`, not two helpers.
